summary: If you want to fix online learning for BIPOC #k12 and #HigherEd students you need A: BIPOC students and teachers. and B: Faculty that teach. Public research universities have neither of those things.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
If you want to fix online learning for BIPOC #k12 and #HigherEd students you need A: BIPOC students and teachers. and B: Faculty that teach.

Public research universities have neither of those things.
